newsitem.title: USA: Otis Elevator names Stephen Page president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Otis Elevator names Stephen Page president/CEO.

text.p: Otis Elevator Co., a unit of United Technologies Corp., said Wednesday it named Stephen F. Page as president and chief executive officer.
His appointment takes effect on April 1, the company said.
Page succeeds Jean-Pierre van Rooy, 62, who will become Otis chairman on that date.
Page, 56, is chief financial officer of United Technologies, and will retain the post until a successor is named, the company said.
The move was made in preparation of van Rooy's retirement in March 1998, United Technologies President and Chief Executive George David said.
Van Rooy has been with Otis since 1970. Page joined the company in 1993 from Black & Decker Corp.
The Farmington, Conn.-based Otis is the world's biggest maker of elevators and escalators.
It had 1995 revenues of $5.3 billion, of which 85 percent was generated outside of the U.S.
